info.name: Leadership Intelligence Scoring Engine
info.description: Every endpoint of the API. Start the stack with `docker compose up -d --build`, then run folder 1 top to bottom. Tokens come from the local mock identity provider (client_id = persona: owner, admin, leader, analyst, viewer, org1-viewer, other-admin, platform-admin, assess-admin, respondent-1 to respondent-6). Change the collection variable "persona" to act as another role.

exec: // Fetches (and caches) a token from the local mock identity provider for the persona in use.
// Persona: header X-Persona on the request (removed before sending), else the collection variable "persona".
if (cached && Date.now() < exp) { pm.variables.set('accessToken', cached); return; }
if (err || res.code !== 200) { throw new Error('token request failed for persona ' + persona + ': ' + (err || res.text())); }

request.description: Server generates the assessmentId and stores an immutable snapshot. Optional header Idempotency-Key. Roles: OWNER, ADMIN, ENGINEERING_LEADER. Saves assessmentId and scoringRunId.

exec: pm.test('carries the diagnostic notice', () => pm.expect(b.notice).to.include('not an individual performance rating'));

request.description: Coverage below the configured requirement gives scoreStatus INSUFFICIENT_DATA, never an invented score.

item.name: Calculate with member answers (organization and team results)

request.description: Answers carry a scope (D45): MEMBER (one respondent, no identity), TEAM or ORGANIZATION. The response is the organization run (all answers pooled) with teamRuns; a team with fewer answers than the configured minimum (default 5) has no score. Send inputs or responses, never both. Saves scopedRunId and teamRunId.

exec: pm.test('organization result with two team results', () => { pm.expect(b.scope).to.eql('ORGANIZATION'); pm.expect(b.teamRuns.length).to.eql(2); });

request.description: A team run reads like any run, with scope TEAM, its teamId and organizationScoringRunId. It is never part of history, trends, the dashboard or comparison.

exec: pm.test('team scope', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.scope).to.eql('TEAM'); pm.expect(b.teamId).to.eql('alpha'); });

Run the folder top to bottom. It can be run again: names are unique per run and the roster is moved, not duplicated.

item.name: Create a team in an organization the token does not carry -> 403
Put the five respondents on the team

request.description: The script adds or moves respondent1@demo.test to respondent5@demo.test onto the team; the request then lists the team. The read is audited.

exec: // Puts the five respondents on the team: adds the people who are not on the roster yet and moves the ones who are (the roster
// is permanent, so this collection can be run again).
pm.sendRequest({ url: base + '/api/v1/people', method: 'GET', header: auth }, (e, r) => {
const body = found ? { teamId: teamId, name: 'Respondent ' + n, email: email, active: true } : { teamId: teamId, name: 'Respondent ' + n, email: email };
pm.sendRequest({ url: base + '/api/v1/people' + (found ? '/' + found.id : ''), method: found ? 'PUT' : 'POST', header: auth, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(body) } }, (e2, r2) => {
if (e2 || r2.code >= 300) { throw new Error('could not put ' + email + ' on the team: ' + (r2 ? r2.code : e2)); }
pm.test('five active people on the team', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().filter((p) => p.teamId === pm.collectionVariables.get('teamId') && p.active).length).to.eql(5));

request.description: The read is audited. Respondents 2 to 5 answer in the script of this request.

exec: // Respondents 2 to 5 answer in this request's script: each gets a token, saves a draft and submits.
const answers = { answers: [1, 2, 3, 4].map((n) => ({ questionId: 'Q0' + n, answer: 2 })) };

body: { mode: 'urlencoded', urlencoded: [{ key: 'grant_type', value: 'client_credentials' }, { key: 'client_id', value: 'respondent-' + n }, { key: 'client_secret', value: 'secret' }] } }, (e, r) => {
pm.sendRequest({ url: base + '/api/v1/respond/runs/' + runId + '/draft', method: 'PUT', header: h, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(answers) } }, (e2, r2) => {
if (e2 || r2.code !== 200) { throw new Error('respondent-' + n + ' could not save a draft: ' + (r2 ? r2.code : e2)); }
pm.sendRequest({ url: base + '/api/v1/respond/runs/' + runId + '/submit', method: 'POST', header: h }, (e3, r3) => {
if (e3 || r3.code !== 200) { throw new Error('respondent-' + n + ' could not submit: ' + (r3 ? r3.code : e3)); }
pm.test('the list holds a person and a status, never an answer', () => d.participants.forEach((p) => pm.expect(Object.keys(p).sort()).to.eql(['email', 'name', 'status', 'teamId'])));
pm.test('the notice about small teams', () => pm.expect(d.notice).to.include('who is missing'));

item.name: 7. Configuration management
item.description: Drafting, validating, previewing, submitting and approving scoring configuration, with a second person and a fixtures gate. Runs in the scratch organization org-assess (personas assess-admin and assess-owner) with an empty override, so no score of any other test changes; the platform default is drafted and reviewed but not approved. Run it after folder 6 (it uses the variable stamp).
